cards.name: Doors
cards.category: 3D Motion (hidden legacy item; not listed in the current Effects panel, reachable by name through QE)
cards.summary: The incoming clip arrives as two door panels that swing in from the left and right edges in fake 3D and close over the outgoing clip.
use_for: Ironic or retro 'old TV news' parody beat in satire reels
Scene reveal 'behind closed doors' gag in political explainers
Deliberately cheap throwback segment where the kitsch is the joke
avoid: Serious documentary or news: reads as wedding-video 2005
Faces near frame centre get squashed by the perspective panels
Stacking with other 3D gimmicks in the same edit
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: Barn Doors (Wipe) for a flat centre split, or Flip Motion / 3D Spin (new GPU 3D transitions in this build) for a modern 3D move. (Cube Spin and Flip Over are not in the v26 transition list.) AE: precomp clip B, duplicate it, mask left and right halves, make both 3D layers with anchor points on the outer frame edges and animate Y Rotation from +/-90 to 0 (add a camera for perspective).
cards.scripting: Applied by name via QE addTransition; harvest placed a 1 s centred instance at 65.52-66.52 s around a cut at 66.0 s (start 0.48 s before, end 0.52 s after: one-frame rounding). Centred needs handles on both clips. Hidden legacy items have no Effects-panel entry, so a planner should prefer Barn Doors unless the retro look is intended.

verified.note: B arrives as two perspective door panels hinged at the left and right edges, swinging in over A and nearly closed by 0.3 s after the cut.

cards.name: Film Dissolve (Legacy)
cards.summary: Older version of Film Dissolve: a cross-fade blended in linear light so bright areas bleed through first, like an optical film dissolve rather than a flat video mix.
use_for: Time-passing dissolves in documentaries
Soft memorial or archival photo sequences
Slow trailer beats between wide landscape shots
Montage of archival news footage
avoid: Fast social reels: a long dissolve kills pace
Dark to bright shots can flash the highlights earlier than expected
Use the current Film Dissolve for new edits instead of this legacy copy
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: Film Dissolve (current version, same Dissolve folder). AE: overlap the layers and fade the top layer's Opacity 100->0 with Project Settings > Blend Colors Using 1.0 Gamma (or a linearized working space) for the same linear-light mix.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 69.52-70.52 s around the cut at 70.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips; single-sided at a clip start or end it fades from or to transparency (black when nothing is below). Prefer the name 'Film Dissolve' for new work; the legacy item is kept for old projects.

verified.note: Cross-fade where B's bright pale areas bleed through A first, giving a filmic highlight-led mix rather than a flat 50/50 blend.

cards.name: Fold Up
cards.category: 3D Motion (hidden legacy item; not listed in the current Effects panel, reachable by name through QE)
cards.summary: The outgoing clip folds in half like a sheet of paper (the right half folds onto the left, then the remaining panel folds again, showing its mirrored back), shrinking panel by panel until it disappears and reveals the incoming clip behind it.
use_for: Ironic 'case closed' or 'file folded away' gag in satire reels
Kids or education explainers with a paper/craft theme
Retro parody of old news packages
avoid: Serious news or documentary: reads as a cheap preset
Long durations make the folding look slow and clunky
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: Page Peel or Flip Motion (new GPU transitions; Flip Over is not in the v26 list). AE: split clip A into halves as 3D precomps and rotate one half 180 deg on the crease, nesting the result and repeating per fold; or approximate with CC Page Turn (small Fold Radius) keyed in steps.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 73.52-74.52 s around the cut at 74.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Works single-sided at a clip end (folds away to black or the track below). Hidden legacy item, no Effects-panel entry.

verified.note: A shrinks panel by panel as it folds: right half gone 0.3 s before, then a quarter-size mirrored panel at the cut, then a small panel, revealing B behind.

cards.name: Iris Cross
cards.summary: The incoming clip appears as a plus-shaped cross whose arms run edge to edge and widen, squeezing the outgoing clip into four shrinking corner rectangles until the incoming clip fills the frame.
use_for: Hospital, aid or Red-Cross themed explainer beats
Graphic section break in a political explainer
Retro TV-style bumper in satire content
avoid: Reads as dated in cinematic trailers
The cross arms cut straight through a centred face or lower-third text early in the transition
cards.equivalent: AE: two rectangle shape layers on one shape layer (a full-width horizontal bar and a full-height vertical bar crossing at the centre), keyframe both bar thicknesses from 0 to full frame, and use it as an Alpha Matte for clip B over clip A.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 77.52-78.52 s around the cut at 78.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Effect Controls offer border width/colour, reverse, anti-alias and centre position, but the bridge applies defaults (centre of frame, no border).

verified.note: B shows as a widening edge-to-edge plus shape, squeezing A into four shrinking corner rectangles.

cards.name: Iris Diamond
cards.summary: The incoming clip opens from the centre in an expanding diamond-shaped iris until it covers the frame.
use_for: Graphic chapter break in explainers
Retro game-show style reveal in satire reels
Title card reveal over a background plate
avoid: Looks cheap in cinematic or serious documentary work
Long durations make the expanding shape feel sluggish
cards.equivalent: AE: a square shape layer rotated 45 deg and scaled non-uniformly to the frame aspect, scaling from 0 until its edges pass the frame corners, used as an Alpha Matte for clip B. (Transition > Iris Wipe cannot make a diamond: its Iris Points minimum is 6.)
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 81.52-82.52 s around the cut at 82.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Border, reverse and centre controls exist in Effect Controls; the bridge applies defaults.

verified.note: B opens from the centre as a growing hard-edged diamond until only A's corner triangles remain.

cards.name: Iris Points
cards.category: Iris (hidden legacy item; not listed in the current Effects panel, reachable by name through QE)
cards.summary: The incoming clip pushes in from all four frame edges as four triangles (points), squeezing the outgoing clip into a shrinking diagonal X shape.
use_for: Retro parody or meme segment in satire reels
Abstract graphic break when an X / 'cancelled' feel is wanted
avoid: Serious news or documentary: reads as old preset
The X shape cuts across faces at the frame centre
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: Iris Cross (current Iris folder) for a similar geometric reveal. AE: four triangle shape layers animated in from the edges, merged and used as an Alpha Matte for clip B.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 85.52-86.52 s around the cut at 86.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Hidden legacy item, no Effects-panel entry.

verified.note: B pushes in from all four edges as triangles, leaving A as a thinning diagonal X.

cards.name: Iris Round
cards.summary: The incoming clip opens from the centre in an expanding circle until it fills the frame: the classic iris-out.
use_for: Reveal a subject or location from the frame centre in explainers
Spotlight reveal of a key document, headline or portrait centred in frame
Comic cartoon iris-close in satire reels: use Shape Flow instead (it closes a circle to a point over black, then opens on the next clip); Iris Round's default cannot do this
avoid: Default centre misses an off-centre subject; the bridge cannot move it
Too slow reads as amateur in trailers
Expecting a 'That's all folks' close at a clip end: the default is the opposite (a black hole grows from the centre)
cards.equivalent: PR: Shape Flow (new transition) for a circle that closes on A and reopens on B through black. AE: ellipse shape layer (or mask) as an Alpha Matte for clip B, scaling from 0 past the frame diagonal with ease; or Transition > Iris Wipe with Iris Points 32 (near-circle) animating Outer Radius.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 89.52-90.52 s around the cut at 90.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Single-sided at a clip end, the default (Reverse off) grows a black or track-below disc from the centre outward; it is not an iris-close. Reverse, centre position, border width/colour and anti-aliasing are Effect Controls settings the bridge does not set: defaults only (frame centre, no border).

verified.note: B opens from the centre as a growing hard-edged circle, almost frame-filling 0.3 s after the cut.

cards.name: Iris Shapes
cards.category: Iris (hidden legacy item; not listed in the current Effects panel, reachable by name through QE)
cards.summary: The incoming clip opens through several small shapes that grow until they merge and fill the frame; the default seen in the harvest is a row of three diamonds across the middle (shape type and rows/columns are Custom settings).
use_for: Retro pattern break in satire or meme reels
Playful education explainer section change
avoid: Busy and cheap in news or documentary
Shape type and grid count are Custom settings the bridge cannot set
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: Iris Diamond / Iris Box for a single shape. AE: Transition > CC Grid Wipe (Shape: Doors/Radial/Rectangular) or a repeated shape layer (Repeater) scaling up as an Alpha Matte.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 93.52-94.52 s around the cut at 94.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. The shape type and count live in the transition's Custom dialog, which scripts cannot reach: defaults only. Hidden legacy item.

verified.note: B opens through a row of three diamonds across the middle that grow and merge until they cover A.

cards.name: Iris Box
cards.summary: The incoming clip opens from the centre in an expanding rectangle (keeping the frame's aspect) until it fills the frame.
use_for: Mimic a news 'window' growing to full screen in reels
Explainer reveal from a centre box
Hard graphic chapter break
avoid: Can look like a clumsy PiP if the duration is long
Hard edge without a border looks unfinished on busy footage
cards.equivalent: AE: rectangle mask or rectangle shape layer at frame aspect, centred, scaling from 0 to 100% as an Alpha Matte for clip B (B's picture stays fixed while the window grows). Scaling clip B itself up from 0% is a different look (zoom-from-point), not an iris.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 97.52-98.52 s around the cut at 98.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Border, reverse and centre controls exist in Effect Controls; the bridge applies defaults.

verified.note: B opens from the centre as a growing frame-aspect rectangle over A.

cards.name: Iris Star
cards.category: Iris (hidden legacy item; not listed in the current Effects panel, reachable by name through QE)
cards.summary: The incoming clip opens from the centre in an expanding five-point star until it fills the frame: the notorious star wipe.
use_for: Intentional comedy beat in satire reels (the star wipe is a meme)
Mock 'award' or 'celebrity' reveal in political roast content
avoid: Any serious news, documentary or trailer use
Overuse kills the joke: once per video at most
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: Star Wipe (new transition in this build; harvest frames show the same centre star reveal). AE: a Star shape layer (Polystar, 5 points) scaling from 0 past the frame corners as an Alpha Matte for clip B; Transition > Iris Wipe with Use Inner Radius on can also make a star, but its Iris Points minimum is 6 and the setting for a 5-point star (likely 10, counting inner vertices) is unverified.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 101.52-102.52 s around the cut at 102.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Hidden legacy item; prefer 'Star Wipe' (present in the harvested transition list).

verified.note: B opens from the centre as a growing five-point star until only slivers of A remain at the edges.

cards.name: Luminance Map
cards.category: Map (hidden legacy item; not listed in the current Effects panel, reachable by name through QE)
cards.summary: Blends the two clips by brightness: during the transition the picture turns into a harsh, near-monochrome high-contrast mix where one clip's luminance drives the other, then resolves into the incoming clip.
use_for: Dark, unsettling transition in a crime or conspiracy segment
Abstract music-video style beat in reels
Flash-of-memory moment in a trailer
avoid: Colour drops to near black-and-white mid-transition, a jarring break in a graded edit
Unpredictable: the result depends entirely on the brightness of both shots
Serious news use
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: Luma Fade (new transition: a cleaner brightness-driven dissolve that keeps colour). Gradient Wipe exists in v26 only as a video effect, not a transition. AE: Transition > Gradient Wipe with Gradient Layer set to the outgoing clip itself (luma-driven reveal), optionally with Hue/Saturation desaturation and Levels contrast keyed over the overlap for the harsh mono look.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 105.52-106.52 s around the cut at 106.0 s; the gallery frames show a grayscale, high-contrast mix mid-transition. Exact blend maths is not documented here, hence low confidence. Centred needs handles on both clips; single-sided behaviour against black/transparency is untested, so avoid it.

verified.note: Both clips collapse into a harsh near-monochrome high-contrast luma mix with blown white patches, still mixed 0.3 s after the cut.

cards.name: Multi-Spin
cards.category: Slide (hidden legacy item; not listed in the current Effects panel, reachable by name through QE)
cards.summary: The incoming clip appears as a grid of small rotated tiles scattered over the outgoing clip; the tiles spin and grow until they join into the full frame.
use_for: Retro 'breaking news' parody in satire reels
Energetic collage break in a meme compilation
avoid: Very busy: hides faces and text during the transition
Reads as early-2000s preset in any serious edit
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: none direct; 3D Spin or Cross Zoom (new transitions) for energy. (Cube Spin is not in the v26 list.) AE: Transition > Card Wipe (Flip Axis and Flip Direction Random, about 4x4 rows/columns) or CC Grid Wipe; for a true match, a grid of precomp tiles with Rotation and Scale keyframes offset in time.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 109.52-110.52 s around the cut at 110.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. The tile grid count is a Custom setting scripts cannot set. Hidden legacy item.

verified.note: B appears as a 4x3 grid of small rotated tiles over A that spin and grow toward joining into the full frame.

cards.name: Page Turn
cards.summary: The outgoing clip folds away from the top-left corner along a straight diagonal crease, like a book page turned flat; the folded-over flap shows the clip mirrored, and the incoming clip is revealed underneath. No curl or shading (that is Page Peel).
use_for: Storybook or history chapter turn in documentaries
Turning from one document or newspaper clipping to the next in explainers
Ironic 'next page of the scandal' beat in satire reels
avoid: The mirrored flap shows reversed text and upside-down faces mid-transition
Feels dated in cinematic trailers
Too short and the fold becomes an unreadable flicker
cards.equivalent: PR: Page Peel (new transition) for a shaded curl instead of a flat fold. AE: Distort > CC Page Turn on clip A with a small Fold Radius (min 4) for a crisp flat fold, animating Fold Position from the top-left corner across the frame; Back Page can be the layer itself; clip B underneath.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 113.52-114.52 s around the cut at 114.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Single-sided at a clip end the page turns away to black or the track below. Corner/direction is an Effect Controls setting the bridge does not set: default top-left corner.

verified.note: A folds away from the top-left corner along a straight diagonal crease, the flat flap showing A mirrored, revealing B underneath.

cards.name: Paint Splatter
cards.summary: The incoming clip is revealed through irregular paint-splash blobs that spread until they cover the frame.
use_for: Street, protest or graffiti themed reels
Energetic opener for a youth or campus segment
Satire beat where something gets 'splattered'
avoid: Default splats are flat hard-edged shapes; cheap on cinematic footage
Serious news or documentary
cards.equivalent: AE: Transition > Gradient Wipe with a splatter texture as the Gradient Layer, or an animated ink/paint splatter matte clip used as a Luma Matte for clip B.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 117.52-118.52 s around the cut at 118.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Splatter pattern is fixed; only border and reverse-type controls exist.

verified.note: B is revealed through irregular paint-splash blobs that spread until only small A fragments remain.

cards.name: Peel Back
cards.category: Page Peel (hidden legacy item; not listed in the current Effects panel, reachable by name through QE)
cards.summary: The outgoing clip splits into four quarters at the centre and the quarters peel off one after another (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, then bottom-left in the harvest frames), each curling from the centre toward its outer corner, revealing the incoming clip.
use_for: Retro 'unwrap the reveal' gag in satire reels
Kids or education explainer with a paper theme
avoid: Serious news, documentary or trailer work
Faces at the frame centre are split first
cards.equivalent: PR replacement: Page Peel (current version). AE: split clip A into four masked quadrant precomps and apply Distort > CC Page Turn to each, folding toward its outer corner.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 121.52-122.52 s around the cut at 122.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Hidden legacy item, no Effects-panel entry.

verified.note: A splits into quarters that peel off in turn (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, then bottom-left curling), revealing B.

cards.name: Pinwheel
cards.summary: The incoming clip is revealed by many rotating wedge blades sweeping round the centre like a pinwheel until they fill the frame.
use_for: Retro game-show or quiz segment in explainers
Playful satire reel beat
Kids education content
avoid: Flickery and busy on detailed footage
Reads as cheap in news, documentary and trailers
cards.equivalent: AE: shape layer of N wedge paths (Polystar or a Repeater around the centre) animated in Start/End angle or rotation, used as an Alpha Matte for clip B; Radial Wipe only gives a single blade.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it 1 s centred at 125.52-126.52 s around the cut at 126.0 s. Centred needs handles on both clips. Blade count is a Custom setting scripts cannot set; defaults only.

verified.note: B is revealed by many radial wedge blades rotating around the centre, alternating with A wedges.
